answer: Clawback vesting at the kernel: payouts unlock linearly over 30 epochs, revocable if fraud is proven. The vine of referral bonuses stays pending until each downline clears. A sybil farm faking 500 identities pays 500× gas plus a 30-epoch capital lock, and one fraud proof erases the whole comet tail of unvested rewards. Attacker cost scales with identity count while payoff stays frozen.
